fullTextParagraphs: Personal user manuals are helpful tools for sharing your working style, communication preferences, and other details, making it easier for teams to work together.
Prep your user manual using a template.
Save your user manual to share with others in the future.
Video conferencing with screen sharing or meeting space.
Digital collaboration tool (see templates).
Help your teammates understand how best to work with you.
About this Play
Instructions
A personal user manual for work is a document that outlines an individual's work style, preferences, strengths, and communication habits.

Running the My User Manual Play creates a dedicated safe space for teams to reduce misunderstanding by clarifying expectations and sharing how best to collaborate with a specific co-worker. Research shows that making work process preferences explicit benefits collaboration.

You should create a user manual at work when joining a new team, taking on a leadership role, or starting a project that requires close collaboration. It can also be useful during team-building activities or when communication issues arise. Essentially, it's beneficial anytime you want to improve clarity and teamwork with colleagues.
Improved communication: It clarifies your preferred communication style, which research shows reduces misunderstandings and improves performance.
Stronger collaboration: Colleagues gain insights into how you work best, fostering more effective teamwork.
Faster onboarding: New team members can quickly understand your strengths, preferences, and work habits, speeding up integration.
Conflict prevention: By setting clear expectations, research shows you help prevent potential conflicts or frustration around work styles and interactions.
Increased productivity: When colleagues know how to engage with you efficiently, it reduces time spent on miscommunication and boosts overall productivity.

Before the meeting, ask each team member to fill out a user manual using one of the provided templates or by creating their own. Let them know that they can choose to answer the prompts they feel comfortable sharing. Here are some ideas to get them started:
What is your work and life set up?
Where do you typically work from?
What work hours do you keep?
What are the best ways to communicate with you?
What are the worst ways to communicate with you?
What communication channels do you prefer?
How do you like to receive feedback?
What formats for feedback work for you?
What are your top 3 values in life?
What is your proudest achievement ever?
We’ve provided prompts in the template but we encourage you to make it your own with bold colors, plentiful memes, and random factoids.

Have team members join the meeting with their personal user manuals. For remote teams, setup a video conference with screen sharing. For in-person teams, have a meeting space that lets you share your user manual. If you’re sharing a physical copy, be sure to share a digital copy of your user manual as well. Next, share the rules for the Play.
This activity is designed for team members to understand how to support each other’s ideal conditions for getting their best work done.
No one will be pressured to share anything they’re not comfortable sharing.
This meeting is a safe space. Nothing they share will be used against them.
When new hires start, assign them the task of creating and presenting their user manual in their first 90 days.
Each team member shares their user manual with the team and answers any questions teammates have on the content.
Keep your team’s user manuals archived in your team's Confluence space or other file-sharing space so future teammates can quickly learn.
For a shorter meeting, try limiting the template to questions about working hours, ideal environment, communication preferences, and learning styles before discussing anything longer and deeper.
Have team members complete a personality test or training together, such as DiSC, Strengths Finder, or Myers-Briggs. Share and discuss the results as a team.
Start a conversation with other Atlassian Team Playbook users, get support, or provide feedback.
Better meetings start with a page that outlines the purpose, expected outcomes, and key discussion points.
Provide a safe space to discuss what worked and what didn’t.

scenario.title: Creating a personal work manual for a new team
english: You have joined a cross-functional team, and colleagues are learning how each other prefers to work.
Atlassian’s personal work manual introduces someone’s work style, communication preferences, strengths, and expectations.
You suggest creating a short manual and saving it in the shared team space.
chinese: 你加入了一个跨职能团队，大家正在了解彼此的工作方式。
Atlassian 的个人工作说明书用于介绍工作风格、沟通偏好、优势和协作预期。
你建议每个人写一份简短说明，并放到团队共享空间。

firstAttempt.prompt: 新同事加入团队，大家想互相了解工作习惯和沟通偏好。请用英文写一段简短的个人工作说明，介绍适合自己的工作方式和反馈偏好，并邀请同事告诉你怎样配合更好。
firstAttempt.sample: I do my best work when I have time to focus before a discussion. I prefer to receive feedback in writing before our one-on-one. Please let me know if a different format would work better for you.
firstAttempt.rationale: 用具体偏好帮助同事了解如何与你合作，并邀请他们提出自己的需要。

words.example: I keep my work manual up to date so teammates know how I prefer to communicate.
words.translation: 我会及时更新自己的工作说明书，让同事了解我偏好的沟通方式。
words.note: 在职场环境中，manual常指操作指南或工作流程说明

words.example: Sharing our work manuals can make collaboration smoother.
words.translation: 分享工作说明书可以让协作更顺畅。
words.note: 现代职场中，collaboration强调不同背景和专长的人共同工作

words.example: Please include your communication preferences in the manual.
words.translation: 请在说明书里写上你的沟通偏好。
words.note: 在职场环境中，明确个人偏好有助于提高工作满意度和效率

words.example: Knowing how a teammate prefers to work can prevent misunderstandings.
words.translation: 了解同事偏好的工作方式，可以减少误解。
words.note: 职场中的misunderstanding常因文化差异或沟通不畅造成

words.example: We can use the manual to clarify expectations when we start working together.
words.translation: 开始协作时，我们可以用这份说明明确彼此的预期。
words.note: 在职场中，明确expectations是成功管理项目和关系的关键

words.example: The manual can mention the conditions that help you do your best work.
words.translation: 说明书可以写明哪些工作条件有助于你发挥。
words.note: performance在职场中常用于评估工作成果和效率

structure.original: Personal user manuals are helpful tools for sharing your working style, communication preferences, and other details, making it easier for teams to work together.
analysis: 主语是“Personal user manuals”；personal 修饰 user manuals。
谓语“are helpful tools”是系表结构；“for sharing…”说明这些 tools 的用途，sharing、communication preferences 和 other details 是并列内容。
“making it easier for teams to work together”表示结果；it 是形式宾语，真正的内容是 for teams to work together，easier 是宾语补足语。
structure.transfer: A one-page work manual can tell teammates how I prefer to receive updates, make decisions, and ask for feedback.

rewrite.bad: I am flexible about everything, so the team can decide how I should work.
rewrite.good: I do my best work when I have time to focus before a discussion. I prefer to receive feedback in writing before our one-on-one. Please let me know if a different format would work better for you.
rewrite.translation: 如果讨论前能留出专注时间，我的工作状态最好。一对一会议前，我更希望先收到书面反馈。如果其他形式对你更合适，请告诉我。
rewrite.pattern: I do my best work when [condition]. I prefer [communication or feedback style]. Please let me know if [another option] works better for you.

cloze.prompt: I do my best work ___ I have time to focus before a discussion.
cloze.why: 用 when 说明自己发挥最好的工作条件。

cloze.prompt: I prefer to receive feedback in ___ before our one-on-one.
cloze.why: in writing 清楚表达偏好的反馈渠道。

cloze.prompt: Please let me know ___ a different format would work better for you.
cloze.why: if 引出对方可以提出调整的情况。

options: You need to make a manual so we know how to work with you. Do it by Friday.
Could each of us create a short work user manual with our working style and communication preferences? We can save them in the team space so people can refer to them when collaborating.

choice.why: 工作使用说明书的价值是分享个人协作偏好，并让团队之后能随时查阅。

output.prompt: 你将和一位新项目搭档合作一个月。请用英文说明你通常怎样接收任务、遇到不确定时会怎么做，并邀请对方提出自己的合作偏好。
output.sample: I work best when a task includes a clear outcome, deadline, and owner. If something is unclear, I’ll ask early rather than make assumptions. How do you prefer to share updates and questions?
